title: LocalSend — Transfer Test
script: I tested LocalSend against a cloud transfer with exactly the same files. One hundred photos, a one-gigabyte video, and a five-gigabyte folder. The timer includes sending and receiving. The cloud route includes upload and download. I checked the received files, then interrupted Wi-Fi during a separate recovery test. [DATASET_TIMES]. [HASH_AND_RECOVERY_RESULT]. [LOCAL_USE_CASE_AND_REMOTE_LIMIT]. Would you use it for devices on the same network?
timingStatus: Estimated silent editorial timings. Refit scenes and caption timestamps to the unchanged voice-over when supplied.
concept: 100 photos, 1GB video and 5GB folder; integrity, discovery, speed and dropped Wi-Fi.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: I tested LocalSend against a cloud transfer with exactly the same files.
Five gigabytes. Same files. Two routes.
A fast transfer still has to arrive intact.
strongestHook: I tested LocalSend against a cloud transfer with exactly the same files.
directorBrief: Direct this as a fair matched test with a scoped recommendation: 100 photos, 1GB video and 5GB folder; integrity, discovery, speed and dropped Wi-Fi. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Prepare 100 synthetic photos, a video with documented 1GB decimal byte size and a folder totaling documented 5GB decimal bytes. Reuse identical source bytes for LocalSend and a named cloud provider. Record device/network specs and cloud plan. Time each from send/upload start to destination files usable; cloud includes upload and download. Compare counts and SHA-256 hashes. Run interrupted-Wi-Fi recovery separately on an isolated test network and record resume/restart/error behavior.
evidenceRequirements: Identical files; verify checksums and real duration.
